title: Ajv strict mode rejects `required` inside `if`/`then`, `not` and `oneOf`
symptoms: strict mode: required property "resolvedBy" is not defined
strict mode: required property "interfaceHash" is not defined at "https://poetics.dev/schemas/unit.schema.json#/then/not/anyOf/0" (strictRequired)
strict mode: required property "units" is not defined at "https://poetics.dev/schemas/adapter-response.schema.json#/properties/files/items/oneOf/0" (strictRequired)
cause: Ajv's `strictRequired` wants every required property declared in the same schema object, and a `then` branch, a `oneOf` branch, or a `not`/`anyOf` inside one, is its own object.
fix: Declare the property in the branch too: `"then": { "properties": { "resolvedBy": true }, "required": ["resolvedBy"] }`. To forbid a property in a branch, set it to `false` under `properties` (`"interfaceHash": false`) instead of `not: { required }`. For alternatives (`oneOf`), write each branch as a full object with its own `properties`, `required` and `additionalProperties`, as `files` items in `adapter-response.schema.json` do.
